rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claims 64, 65 and 68: which links a page offers is look and feel, the prototype decides look and feel and wins by default, and the real service changes to match; claim 66 and claim 94 keep the contact edit route itself, because whether a route exists is architecture the prototype never decides; no DR1 judgement or real constraint (ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 9 to 11) asks for a link to it.
outcome: No new link is added. Whether and where a page links to the contact edit route is look and feel, which the prototype decides, and Design Release 2.1 offers no way to edit the chosen contact on the contact page or the review. So the contact page shows the radios alone (c-125, req-774), the review drops its 'Edit details' links (c-138), and the /consignment/contact/edit route and its copy-only edit form stay in the service unchanged (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 claim 94, req-775), because removing a route is architecture the prototype never decides. Nothing in the journey opens the route until a later ruling or design names an entry point.
